lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The complaints folder got too thick to close. Late orders, smudged copies, a box that arrived in pieces. Corporate sent a form letter. You were the form.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Turns out people noticed you weren't helping them. Someone else will not help them now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You sent away more business than the store did all quarter. The regional manager drew a chart about it.
